两界：我的金手指有点无敌最新章节_第15章 青云观第1页_两界：我的金手指有点无敌晨钟敲暮鼓_热点小说网
> 第15章 青云观（第1页）
姐妹已经习惯了顾铮的‘土豪’，只当顾铮在谦虚，慕璃连连推辞：“真的不行，你买了三十份归元壮血汤药材，我们已经占了便宜，再拿你的饰品，岂不是贪得无厌？”
慕盼没有像过去那般催促姐姐接受，一言不发放下很喜欢的簪子。
顾铮看着慕璃：“我买药材，你负责熬制，药汤算是报酬，不能和这些饰品混为一谈，这些是我为了感谢师父昨天救我一命。”
他和慕璃相识不到一天，虽然拜师了，但关系谈不上亲密，但李婶去请她帮忙的时候是没有丝毫犹豫，立刻就答应的。
感受到顾铮诚挚的语气，慕璃反而有些不好意思了，脸蛋泛红，显得肌肤越发白皙娇嫩，羞怯道：“其实我也没做什么，那鬼物被你烧的已经半死，再加上刀的锋利，才瞬间杀死。”
“好了！都是练武之人，爽快点，不要婆婆妈妈了！”
顾铮两人最喜欢的饰品塞进他们手里：“拿着吧。”
慕盼看着姐姐，征求她的意见，慕璃是非常喜欢这些小饰品的，沉吟了一下微微点头，慕盼欢呼一声，取下头上的簪子，用新的簪子取代：“姐姐，好看么？”
慕璃戴上一个手链，皓腕凝霜雪，煞是漂亮。
两姐妹一一尝试新饰品，玩的不亦乐乎。
左边小财迷妹妹，右边美人儿师父，顾铮左看看，右看看，亦是不亦乐乎。
顾铮承认自己是一个LSP，假如这一对姐妹不是大美人，他绝对不会这么上心，而且这两姐妹除了美貌，性格也挺好的。
只要你情我愿，反对的都是妖魔鬼怪！
到了中午，顾铮回家了一趟，吃了个饭，顺便去温伦家瞧了瞧，果然不见人影，卧房中能闻到丝丝血腥之气。
从他家里的摆设也能推断出没有出远门的迹象。
至此，顾铮认为温伦被‘曲婷婷’害了的可能性已经达到九成九。
让陈叔去衙门里报官，顾铮骑上高头大马直奔五十里之外的青云观。
好在青云观所在的地方不是很偏僻，大乾的官道修的还可以，全程基本上都在官道上奔驰，大约两个小时之后就到了青云观所在的青云山。

青云观香火不错，是方圆百里名气最大的道观，位于青云山的半山腰，牵着马上山，迎面碰到了不少下山的香客，穿着大多朴素，偶尔有几个穿着华贵的人。
青云山不高，顾铮估摸着也就四五百米，尽管上山的路不是那么好走，半个小时之后也看到了青云观的匾额。
青云观三个大字潇洒俊逸，配合山中安静的环境，颇有些出尘的意味。
门口牌楼两边各有一尊栩栩如生的石狮，右边的石壁上雕刻着流云、仙鹤、花卉等图案，其刀法浑厚，造型精美。
中间券门东侧浮雕中隐藏着一个巴掌大小的石猴，已被香客摸得锃亮。
来上香的香客中流传一句话：“神仙本无踪，只留石猴在观中”，这石猴便成了神仙的化身，来青云观的香客都要用手摸摸它，讨个吉利。
观内共有小石猴三只，分别藏在不同的地方，若不诚心寻找，难以见到，故有“三猴不见面”之说。
迎客道人看到顾铮一身锦衣，身姿挺拔，相貌俊朗，目如朗星，炯炯有神，主动迎了上来，竖掌躬身：“福生无量天尊，公子是来上香祈福的吗？”
“道长。”顾铮拱拱手：“在下不是来上香的，而是霍道长让我来青云观寻他的。”
迎客道人有些失望，还以为来了个大生意呢。
普通的香客来上香，也就是烧几根香，投几文钱求个平安。
而某些有钱的香客则不同，哄的高兴了，比得上几百个普通香客。
不过听到顾铮和霍大人有关系，他也不敢怠慢，那可是观主的好友。

> Chapter 15 Qingyun Temple (Page 1)
The sisters have become accustomed to Gu Zheng's 'richness', and they only think that Gu Zheng is being modest. Mu Li refuses: "It's really not possible. You bought thirty portions of Guiyuan Zhuangxue Decoction medicinal materials, and we have already taken advantage. If we take your jewelry again, wouldn't it be greedy?"
Mu Pan did not urge her sister to accept it as she did in the past, and gave away the hairpin she liked without saying a word.
Gu Zheng looked at Mu Li: "I buy the medicinal materials and you are responsible for brewing them. The medicinal soup is considered as payment and cannot be confused with these accessories. These are my thanks to Master for saving my life yesterday."
He and Mu Li had known each other for less than a day. Although they were apprentices, their relationship was not close. However, when Aunt Li asked her for help, she agreed immediately without any hesitation.
Feeling Gu Zheng's sincere tone, Mu Li felt a little embarrassed. Her face turned red and her skin became whiter and more delicate. She said shyly: "Actually, I didn't do anything. You burned the ghost to half death. Coupled with the sharpness of the knife, it killed it instantly."
"Okay! We are all martial arts practitioners, please be more relaxed and don't want mother-in-law and mother-in-law!"
Gu Zheng put their favorite jewelry into their hands: "Take it."
Mu Pan looked at her sister and asked for her opinion. Mu Li liked these trinkets very much. She pondered for a moment and nodded slightly. Mu Pan cheered, took off the hairpin on her head and replaced it with a new one: "Sister, does it look good?"
Mu Li put on a bracelet, and her wrists were covered with frost and snow, which was really beautiful.
The two sisters had a great time trying out new accessories one by one.
The little money-loving sister on the left, the beautiful master on the right. Gu Zheng looked left and right, feeling very happy.
Gu Zheng admitted that he was an LSP. If these two sisters were not great beauties, he would never be so interested in them. Moreover, in addition to their beauty, these two sisters also had good personalities.
As long as you agree with me, all those who oppose it are monsters and ghosts!
At noon, Gu Zheng went home, had a meal, and took a look at Wen Lun's house. Sure enough, there was no one there, and the slightest smell of blood could be smelled in the bedroom.
It can also be inferred from the furnishings in his home that there are no signs of traveling far away.
At this point, Gu Zheng believed that the possibility of Wen Lun being harmed by 'Qu Tingting' had reached 99%.
Asking Uncle Chen to go to the Yamen to report to the official, Gu Zheng got on his tall horse and went straight to Qingyun Temple, fifty miles away.
Fortunately, the place where Qingyun Temple is located is not very remote, and the official road in Daqian is not bad. We basically ran on the official road the whole way, and we arrived at Qingyun Mountain where Qingyun Temple is located in about two hours.
Qingyun Temple has good incense and is the most famous Taoist temple within a hundred miles. It is located halfway up the Qingyun Mountain. Leading the horse up the mountain, I encountered many pilgrims coming down the mountain. Most of them were dressed in simple clothes, but occasionally there were a few people dressed in luxurious clothes.
Qingyun Mountain is not high, Gu Zheng estimated that it is only four to five hundred meters. Although the road up the mountain is not that easy, half an hour later he saw the plaque of Qingyun Temple.
The three large characters of Qingyun Temple are elegant and elegant, and combined with the quiet environment in the mountains, it has a somewhat mundane meaning.
There are lifelike stone lions on both sides of the archway at the entrance. The stone wall on the right is carved with patterns such as flowing clouds, cranes, flowers, etc. The swordsmanship is vigorous and the shape is exquisite.
There is a palm-sized stone monkey hidden in the relief on the east side of the central gate, which has been touched and polished by pilgrims.
There is a popular saying among the pilgrims who come to offer incense: "There is no trace of the gods, only the stone monkey is left in the temple." This stone monkey has become the incarnation of the gods. Pilgrims who come to Qingyun Temple must touch it with their hands to seek good luck.
There are three little stone monkeys in the temple, and they are hidden in different places. If you are not looking for them sincerely, they will be difficult to see, so there is a saying that "the three monkeys never meet".
The Taoist who welcomed the guests saw that Gu Zheng was dressed in brocade clothes, with a tall and straight figure, handsome appearance, and bright, bright eyes.Jiong Youyou took the initiative to greet him, raised his palms and bowed: "Blessings Immeasurable Heavenly Lord, are you here to offer incense and pray for blessings?"
"Taoist Priest." Gu Zhenggong cupped his hands: "I'm not here to offer incense, but Taoist Priest Huo asked me to come to Qingyun Temple to look for him."
Taoist Yingke was a little disappointed, thinking that a big deal had come.
Ordinary pilgrims come to offer incense, that is, burn a few sticks of incense and invest a few coins to pray for peace.
But some wealthy pilgrims were different. They were so happy that they were as happy as hundreds of ordinary pilgrims.
However, when he heard that Gu Zheng was related to Mr. Huo, he did not dare to neglect him. He was a good friend of the viewer.
